uncertainObservations: The moon's phase is genuinely ambiguous: a bright crescent-shaped lit area runs along the lower-right limb, but the whole circular disc is faintly visible with crater texture, so a 'gibbous'/'full seen through haze' reading cannot be excluded. Recorded as crescent with medium confidence.
The far viewer-left figure's lower body is hidden behind the foreground woman and drapery, so I cannot tell whether she is kneeling, sitting or crouching.
I cannot determine the exact gender of several of the pale-haired figures; I have described hair, dress and build only.
The central woman's raised hand touches her own chin/lips area, but at this resolution I cannot rule out that she is holding a small thin object there.
Whether the child's disc is held purely by the child or jointly with the elder is unclear; the elder's hand is beneath the disc but the contact point is soft-focused.

The ground discs rest on a pale cloth that blends into the flowers at the edges; a further disc hidden under the drapery or behind the dog cannot be fully excluded, though I found none on close inspection.
